title: Was This the Exact Date of Van Gogh’s “Starry Night”? - Nautilus
gist: A Scientific Reports study uses observational geometry, historical weather records and even cicadas to claim astronomers have pinned down the actual date depicted in van Gogh's The Starry Night.

insights.claim: Astronomers writing in Scientific Reports combined observational geometry, historical weather records and cicadas to argue they have determined the actual date of The Starry Night.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Multidisciplinary methods can resolve long-standing art-history questions.

insights.claim: Art historians have debated for decades whether The Starry Night depicts an actual starry night or sprang from van Gogh's imagination.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Background to the debate; low investment relevance.
insights.locator: Art historians have debated the question for decades
